title: Controlled non-random missing privileged part annotation pilot
research_question: Can annotation-support-aware privileged part supervision avoid downstream negative transfer when class labels are complete but part masks are non-randomly observed?

pilot_subset.class_selection: Select the 20 ImageNet classes with the largest train image counts; break ties lexicographically by canonical class/synset identifier.
pilot_subset.train_image_selection: If a class has more than 80 train images, sort by stable SHA256 of experiment_id plus image_id and retain the first 80.
pilot_subset.validation_images: Use all official validation images belonging to the frozen 20 classes.
pilot_subset.manifest_rule: Only train metadata and train masks may be read when generating the frozen manifest. Save image IDs, class IDs, mask-derived quantities, all selection indicators, and SHA256.

representation.patch_feature: final normalized 14x14 visual patch tokens before global projection
representation.pretraining_overlap_caveat: PartImageNet derives from ImageNet and CLIP pretraining data are broad. All pilot arms use the identical frozen encoder and only relative comparisons are admissible.

internal_development.fold_assignment: Within each class, sort by SHA256(experiment_id + image_id + fold_seed) and assign round-robin to folds 0..4.
internal_development.validation_usage: Validation labels and masks may be read only after the train manifest, candidate grid and selected hyperparameters are frozen.
internal_development.hyperparameter_objective: maximize train-OOF balanced accuracy subject to worst-class delta >= -2 percentage points and non-trivial local activation constraints
selection_hierarchy: Select global learning rate and weight decay using GLOBAL five-fold OOF.
Holding the selected global settings fixed, select part-loss weight and gamma using FULL_PART_ORACLE five-fold OOF.
Reuse those settings for NAIVE and CLIPPED_IPW across all mechanisms and seeds.
Select SUPPORT_AWARE threshold and temperature analytically from train OOF predictions only, separately by mechanism, then freeze before validation.
internal_development.tie_breaking: If objectives tie within 1e-8, choose lower model complexity in this order: lower gamma, lower part-loss weight, higher support threshold, lower learning rate, higher weight decay, lower temperature.

annotation_budget.weighted_sampling: Efraimidis-Spirakis weighted sampling without replacement using deterministic NumPy PCG64 streams keyed by experiment_id, mechanism, seed and class.

MCAR.rule: Uniform sample without replacement within each class.

MAR_X.score: negative squared distance of frozen global feature to its train-class centroid
MAR_X.rule: Weighted sample without replacement within class with weights softmax(2 * zscore(score)); selection depends only on observed x and y.

MNAR_Z.score: 0.5 * zscore(log(total visible part-mask area fraction + 1e-6)) + 0.5 * zscore(number of visible canonical parts)
MNAR_Z.rule: Weighted sample without replacement within class with weights softmax(2 * score); selection uses hidden z and is unavailable for unannotated samples.

SI_HARD.rule: Select the highest-scoring exact 20 percent within class, creating a deliberate support hole.

model_family.global_branch: multinomial linear classifier on global feature trained with class-balanced cross entropy on all train images
model_family.part_attention: four trainable linear attention maps over frozen patch tokens
model_family.local_pooling: per-part spatial softmax pooling followed by a class-balanced linear local classifier
model_family.part_loss: per-visible-part BCE plus soft Dice against the 14x14 mask targets

arms.GLOBAL: Classification loss on all train labels; gamma is fixed to zero.
arms.NAIVE: Classification loss on all train labels plus unweighted part loss on selected annotations; activation is one.
arms.CLIPPED_IPW: NAIVE with class-conditional OOF propensity estimates and normalized inverse-propensity part-loss weights clipped to [0.2, 5.0]; activation is one.
arms.SUPPORT_AWARE: CLIPPED_IPW plus activation based on OOF annotation propensity and selected-subset kNN support. Gate threshold, temperature and gamma are chosen only by train OOF safety objective.
arms.FULL_PART_ORACLE: The same architecture with part loss available for every train image; validation masks remain evaluation-only and are never model inputs.

metrics.aggregation: Equal weight over classes, then equal weight over mechanisms and seeds.

go_no_go.phenomenon_required: NAIVE must show at least 2pp additional loss under at least two biased mechanisms relative to MCAR, or at least 5pp worst-class harm.
go_no_go.seed_direction_consistency: All three seeds must agree in sign for the aggregate support-aware delta.
automatic_no_go: FULL_PART_ORACLE fails to exceed GLOBAL by 2pp.
SUPPORT_AWARE passes safety only by activation below 10 percent.
Any test image is decoded or encoded.
Validation is used to choose a candidate or change the frozen grid.
